import html # Predefined template for a blog post. The placeholders {title} and {body} # will be replaced by the sanitized headline and text. BLOG_FORMAT: str = """

{title}

{body}
""" def show_blog_post(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Return a sanitized and formatted blog post ready for safe display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The heading of the blog post. text : str The main body text of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted HTML snippet. """ # Ensure arguments are strings; convert if necessary headline = str(headline) if headline is not None else "" text = str(text) if text is not None else "" # Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Insert sanitized values into the template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_text) # Strip leading/trailing whitespace to keep the output tidy return formatted_post.strip()
